subject: Trial gap policy / pricing guardrail discussion
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena@hummingbird.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@hummingbird.ai
Date: Sun, 27 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial extension + gap coverage question

Hi Priya,

Quick question on our 30-day pilot with Redwood — we hit a short pause in test data collection and need to extend the environment by ~2 weeks. Procurement is concerned about a billing gap if we pause and resume later this quarter. Can you confirm the company policy for small pauses and the commercial options? Our preference is to avoid double-billing and keep the same trial terms if possible.

Also attaching an updated requirements doc so you can see the reason for the pause. We expect the extra run to be mostly model inference (text generation) and a short burst of fine-tuning validation.

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
VP Product
Hummingbird AI

Attachment: hummingbird_poc_requirements.pdf (application/pdf, 142KB)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@hummingbird.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, procure@hummingbird.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial extension + gap coverage question

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for the updated requirements. I reviewed the ask with Product and Commercial. Short answer: we can support a two-week extension with two commercial approaches depending on what you want to lock in.

Option A — Timebox extension (no commitment change):
- Extend the existing pilot window by 14 days.
- No additional commitment required; we bill for incremental runtime/usage only.
- We hold the same per-token rate used in the original trial for the extension period.
- We keep the trial sandbox active but any unused reserved burst hours from the original pilot do not automatically carry forward.

Option B — Gap protection credit pool (recommended if you expect another short pause):
- Convert up to 30% of the current trial allotment into a credit pool that can be re-applied if you pause and resume within 90 days.
- Credit pool charges a nominal fee (we propose USD 1,500) to reserve capacity and avoid re-onboarding/overlap billing.
- Credits are consumed before go-forward billing and can be applied to both hosted and dedicated test runs.

Operational notes:
- We’ll need a brief PO or an email approval to process Option B so Finance can create a credit line; Option A can be approved in-thread.
- I attached our updated trial terms (redwood_trial_terms_v2.pdf) which include a short clause for trial pauses and credit pools.

If you share a preference I’ll loop in Ben for pricing confirmation and Marissa for milestone alignment so we can update the HubSpot deal.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, procure@hummingbird.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial extension + gap coverage question

Hi all — jumping in with the commercial detail on the two options so procurement has clear numbers.

Option A (timebox extension):
- 14 additional days billed at the trial per-token rate: $0.0009 / generation-token equivalent.
- We estimate ~120k tokens for the extra run based on the updated requirements -> approx $108.
- No PO needed; we invoice at month-end as per trial terms.

Option B (credit pool / gap protection):
- One-time fee: $1,500 to reserve a $3,000 credit pool (2x leverage) usable within 90 days.
- If credits go unused after 90 days, we can either refund 50% or roll forward once with a short admin fee.
- For teams planning intermittent pauses, this reduces re-onboarding friction and avoids potential concurrency surcharges.

Recommendation: Option B if you expect more than one short pause, Option A if this is a single short extension. If you confirm Option B, procurement: please send a PO referencing deal HB-2025-POC-042 and we’ll emit an invoice and apply the credit.

Ben

Hi Priya / Ben,

Thanks — Option B sounds like the cleaner path for us; we had another short pause last quarter and want to avoid billing overlap or repeated re-onboarding. Procurement will issue a PO for the $1,500 reserve fee.

Two asks before we sign:
1) Can you confirm that credits will apply to both hosted API usage and one short dedicated burst (we may run a 3-hour dedicated evaluation later this month)?
2) Please confirm who to route the PO to (billing@redwoodinference.com?) and any required invoice fields.

If you can answer those quickly we’ll get the PO over today.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, Hummingbird AI
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, procure@hummingbird.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial extension + gap coverage question

Thanks Elena — short replies to your two asks and next steps: 

1) Credits scope: confirmed. The $3,000 credit pool (via $1,500 reserve) applies to hosted API usage and up to one dedicated burst (up to 6 GPU-hours / single contiguous run). If you exceed that dedicated burst bucket we’ll bill overage at the dedicated transient rate; we’ll notify you before exhausting the credit.

2) PO routing & invoice fields: please route the PO to billing@redwoodinference.com with the following fields: company name, billing address, PO number, deal id (HB-2025-POC-042), contact name and email. We accept ACH or wire; payment terms Net 30. I’ve CC'd Marissa for any legal/terms questions.

Next steps:
- Procurement sends PO referencing HB-2025-POC-042.
- We issue an invoice for $1,500 and activate the credit pool upon receipt.
- Priya will schedule a brief kickoff to add the dedicated burst window to the pilot run if you need it.

If that works I’ll mark the HubSpot deal stage as "Pilot: Credit Reserve" and send a short confirmation email after invoice issuance.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you back up and running.
